verdict.rationale: Terraform docs confirm CLI import brings existing resources into state (terraform-docs-5, terraform-docs-19), but this only imports state — it does not auto-generate matching HCL configuration (older Terraform versions require manually writing config, and community evidence notes gaps handling resources created outside TF, e.g. reliance on unmaintained third-party tools like terraformer). No evidence of the newer `-generate-config-out` config-generation feature is present in the pack, so the 'generate matching configuration code' half of the story is not substantiated.
